title: Buying GPUs Should Work Like Buying Stocks — Carmen Li, Compute Exchange
talk_summary: Carmen Li pitches Compute Exchange, a neutral marketplace for buying/selling reserved GPU capacity, forward contracts, and secondary servers, plus Silicon Data indices for GPU price curves. The talk is a product pitch for GPU procurement and commodity-style hedging, not about running AI agents or LLM workflows.

takeaways.technique: Spot/forward capacity sourcing via neutral marketplace
takeaways.what_they_do: Aggregates 100+ verified GPU providers and routes RFQs to providers with matching inventory, offering reserved and forward contracts instead of on-demand.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we have three providers we think they have those. We'll route them to the three.
takeaways.numbers: 100+ verified providers, 80,000 GPUs in supply, 24-hour turnaround

takeaways.what_they_do: Scores both customers and providers and verifies inventory (UUIDs, benchmarks) before matching, to reduce counterparty risk.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We score you, our customers. We score our providers.
